registeredContainerVsInk.interpretation: Different center/left/spacing contract even when all points transform correctly; not an actual registry asset assertion.

clipboardState.logicOnly: store(A)->tokenA; store(B)->tokenB replaces single slot; read(tokenA)=null. OS token alone cannot restore A after module reload or in another tab.
clipboardState.cutOrder: Source handler stores token then setsData then calls remove. A synchronous setData throw prevents remove, but old slot already replaced. No durable clipboard confirmation; silently unsupported custom MIME/cross-tab/reload can leave cut data unavailable.
